newsitem.title: UK: BG UP ON STOCK SHORTAGE, REGULATION HOPES.
newsitem.headline: BG UP ON STOCK SHORTAGE, REGULATION HOPES.

text.p: Shares in British gas transport and production company BG Plc hit a 3-1/2 year high on Thursday, lifted by a stock shortage and hopes for a final end to a regulatory wrangle, market sources said.
By 0851 GMT, BG shares were up 5-1/2p or 2.1 percent at 262p, on volume of 2.2 million, among the most active in the FTSE 100.
Market sources said BG officials may also present a more upbeat outlook in meetings with analysts.
BG was not immediately available to comment.
Shares were supported by hopes the ongoing war of words between industry regulator Ofgas and BG over price proposals may be coming to an end, market sources said.
No news was cited for the optimism.
"It looks as though this...saga of the Transco pricing formula is close to resolution," said Nigel Hawkins, utilities and transport analyst at Yamaichi.
Transco is the pipeline arm of BG.
Hawkins also said the shares were supported by views the company may announce positive news on its valuation of overseas assets.
However, he has a "sell" rating on the stock, considering its ascent over the last year.
Early buying on Thursday from one market maker for 250,000 shares in BG initially boosted the stock price, sources said.
